policy.sandbox: danger-full-access equally for both arms in disposable synthetic fixtures
policy.native_user_config: ignored except the configured Windows sandbox backend; authentication remains in the original CODEX_HOME
policy.child_environment: parent CODEX_* orchestration context removed except CODEX_HOME; authentication variables retained
policy.external_skills: explicitly disabled except project-local treatment skills
policy.plugins_mcp: disabled equally in every runnable arm
policy.project_documents: disabled equally; Auto-Skills supplies its generated developer policy
policy.usage: native completion events; missing fields remain null; no cost estimate
policy.validators: outside the agent worktree; immutable source hashes checked before/after
policy.timing: elapsed includes fixture creation, setup, inference and final validation; stages also separate
policy.ordering: deterministic arm rotation between repetitions; no independent cache reset
confounds: Auto-Skills includes its developer policy and offline wrappers; it is a treatment bundle, not skills alone.
Offline Auto-Skills does not install RTK/repomix or discover remote winners.
Vercel uses manually selected React guidance and is applicable only to the frontend task.
Autoskills detects the frontend workspace and installs its own pinned-registry recommendations; this adapter covers only that fixture.
SkillRadar uses an unmodified project-local router bundle with an offline pinned registry; it is not a native marketplace install and may not activate on these coding prompts.
Same authentication/home and service caches are retained; cache hits are observed, never assumed.
A requested model identifier is recorded exactly; a mutable service alias is not an immutable model snapshot.
External validators are public and outside the writable worktree, not secret tests or a malicious-code sandbox.
Three small synthetic fixes cannot establish general quality, cost or latency superiority.
policy.auto_skills_treatment: offline prepare_task and task-scoped launch_profile; no hook, no remote skill search; isolated preparation inventory
